title: PHP
description: Modern PHP 8 for web backends: strict types, enums, attributes and match, Composer and PSR autoloading, sessions and forms, PDO with prepared statements, XSS, CSRF and injection defences, PHPUnit, a Laravel overview, buildable projects and interview practice.

categories.title: Environment and Tooling
categories.description: A current PHP interpreter, Composer and the built-in server, so every example runs locally.

topics.title: Installing PHP 8 and the CLI
topics.description: Installing a current PHP with the extensions web work needs (mbstring, pdo, curl, intl), checking php -v and php -m, php.ini settings that matter, and the difference between CLI and web SAPIs.

topics.title: The built-in server and running scripts
topics.description: Running php file.php, reading arguments from $argv, serving a directory with php -S localhost:8000 for development, and using a router script for clean URLs.

topics.title: Composer and autoloading
topics.description: Composer manages dependencies through composer.json and composer.lock, generates a PSR-4 autoloader so classes load by namespace, and separates require from require-dev.

topics.title: PSR standards and coding style
topics.description: What the PHP-FIG PSRs standardise: PSR-1 and PSR-12 coding style, PSR-4 autoloading, PSR-3 logging, PSR-7 and PSR-15 HTTP, and enforcing style with PHP CS Fixer or PHP_CodeSniffer.

topics.title: Static analysis with PHPStan and Psalm
topics.description: PHP is dynamically typed, so PHPStan or Psalm catch type mistakes before runtime; levels, baseline files, phpdoc generics like array<int, User>, and running analysis in CI.

topics.title: PHP tags, statements and strict types
topics.description: How <?php starts code, why files with only PHP omit the closing tag, statements and semicolons, comments, and declare(strict_types=1) to stop silent scalar coercion.

subtopics.title: Opening tag and omitted closing tag

topics.title: Variables, scalars and type juggling
topics.description: Dollar-prefixed variables, int, float, string, bool and null, how loose comparison converts types, the saner comparisons of PHP 8, and casting explicitly.

topics.title: Constants and enums
topics.description: const and define for constants, class constants, and PHP 8.1 enums: pure and backed enums, cases, methods, interfaces on enums, and from and tryFrom for parsing values.

topics.title: Operators and expressions
topics.description: Arithmetic and string concatenation with a dot, strict === versus loose ==, the spaceship <=>, null coalescing ?? and ??=, nullsafe ?->, and the ternary and its short form.

topics.title: Conditions, match and loops
topics.description: if/elseif/else, switch with its loose comparison, the strict match expression that returns a value and throws on no match, for, foreach with keys and references, while and do-while.

topics.title: Defining functions and type declarations
topics.description: Parameters and return types, nullable and union types, default values, named arguments, variadics with ..., and passing by reference.

topics.title: Closures, arrow functions and callables
topics.description: Anonymous functions capturing with use, arrow functions that capture by value automatically, the callable type and first-class callable syntax, and Closure::fromCallable and bind.

topics.title: Higher-order array functions
topics.description: array_map, array_filter, array_reduce, usort with callbacks, array_walk, and why preserving keys matters when filtering.

topics.title: Scope, static variables and recursion
topics.description: Function scope with no access to outer variables unless imported, static locals that persist between calls, the global keyword and why to avoid it, and recursion limits.

subtopics.title: global and why to avoid it

topics.title: Arrays as ordered maps
topics.description: A PHP array is an ordered hash map that serves as list, dictionary and stack; integer and string keys, nested arrays, short syntax and destructuring.

topics.title: Array functions toolbox
topics.description: Counting, searching, slicing and merging: count, in_array, array_search, array_slice, array_splice, array_merge versus the + operator, array_keys, array_column and array_unique.

topics.title: Sorting arrays
topics.description: sort, rsort, asort, ksort and their u-variants, sort flags, stability since PHP 8, and multi-key sorting with the spaceship operator.

topics.title: SPL data structures and iterators
topics.description: SplStack, SplQueue, SplObjectStorage, ArrayObject and the Iterator, IteratorAggregate and Countable interfaces that let objects work with foreach and count.

topics.title: Generators and lazy iteration
topics.description: Functions with yield produce values one at a time, yield with keys, yield from delegation, sending values in, and processing large files or result sets in constant memory.

topics.title: String literals and interpolation
topics.description: Single versus double quotes, escape sequences, interpolating variables and expressions with braces, heredoc and nowdoc, and sprintf and number_format.

topics.title: String functions and multibyte text
topics.description: strlen, substr, strpos, str_contains, str_replace, trim, explode and implode, and why mbstring functions like mb_strlen are required for UTF-8 text.

topics.title: Regular expressions with PCRE
topics.description: preg_match, preg_match_all, preg_replace and preg_split, delimiters and modifiers, named groups, preg_replace_callback and the u modifier for Unicode.

topics.title: Dates and times
topics.description: DateTimeImmutable over DateTime, DateTimeZone, formatting and parsing with format and createFromFormat, DateInterval and DatePeriod arithmetic, and storing UTC.

topics.title: JSON and serialisation
topics.description: json_encode and json_decode with flags like JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR, objects versus associative arrays, JsonSerializable, and why unserialize on untrusted input is dangerous.

topics.title: Errors, warnings and the Error hierarchy
topics.description: Notices, warnings and fatal errors, how PHP 8 turned many into thrown Error objects, TypeError and ValueError, error_reporting and converting warnings with set_error_handler.

topics.title: try, catch, finally and custom exceptions
topics.description: Catching specific classes, multiple types with |, finally for cleanup, chaining with the previous argument, and designing a small exception hierarchy per module.

topics.title: Logging with PSR-3 and Monolog
topics.description: Logging to files, stderr and services with Monolog, log levels, context arrays, handlers and processors, and never logging secrets or full request bodies.

topics.title: Debugging with Xdebug and var_dump
topics.description: var_dump, print_r and dd-style helpers, step debugging with Xdebug in the editor, breakpoints in web requests, and reading stack traces in error pages.

topics.title: Classes, properties and constructors
topics.description: Typed properties, visibility, constructor property promotion, readonly properties and classes, static members, and the new in initialisers feature.

topics.title: Inheritance, abstract classes and interfaces
topics.description: extends and parent::, abstract methods, final, interfaces and constants in interfaces, instanceof, and covariant return and contravariant parameter types.

topics.title: Traits
topics.description: Horizontal reuse by mixing methods into classes, abstract and static members in traits, resolving conflicts with insteadof and as, and when a trait hides a design problem.

topics.title: Magic methods and object behaviour
topics.description: __get, __set and __call for dynamic behaviour, __toString, __invoke, __clone for deep copies, and why objects are passed by handle rather than copied.

topics.title: Namespaces and autoloaded classes
topics.description: Declaring namespaces, use imports and aliases, fully qualified names, functions and constants in namespaces, and how PSR-4 maps a namespace to a file path.

topics.title: Attributes and reflection
topics.description: PHP 8 attributes as structured metadata on classes, methods and properties, reading them with the Reflection API, and how frameworks use them for routing and validation.

topics.title: Dependency injection and interfaces in practice
topics.description: Passing collaborators through constructors, coding to interfaces, a minimal PSR-11 container, and why static calls and global state make code hard to test.

topics.title: The request lifecycle and superglobals
topics.description: How a web server hands a request to PHP-FPM, $_GET, $_POST, $_SERVER and $_FILES, headers with header(), status codes, and why nothing may be output before headers.

topics.title: Handling forms and validation
topics.description: Reading POST data, the post-redirect-get pattern, filter_var and filter_input for validation, sanitising versus validating, and re-populating forms with errors.

topics.title: Sessions and cookies
topics.description: session_start and $_SESSION, session storage and lifetime, cookie flags (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite), regenerating the id on login, and remember-me tokens.

topics.title: File uploads
topics.description: $_FILES structure, validating size and MIME type with finfo, moving files with move_uploaded_file, storing outside the web root, and upload limits in php.ini.

topics.title: Templating and output escaping
topics.description: Separating logic from HTML, alternative syntax for templates, htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES and UTF-8, escaping contexts (HTML, attribute, JS, URL), and Twig as a safer default.

subtopics.title: Escaping for attributes, JS and URLs

topics.title: Connecting with PDO
topics.description: DSNs for MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite, PDO options like ERRMODE_EXCEPTION and default fetch mode, persistent connections, and keeping credentials in the environment.

topics.title: Prepared statements and binding
topics.description: prepare and execute with named or positional placeholders, bindValue types, why prepared statements prevent SQL injection, and the cases placeholders cannot cover such as identifiers and IN lists.

topics.title: Fetching results and transactions
topics.description: fetch, fetchAll and fetchColumn with FETCH_ASSOC and FETCH_CLASS, iterating large result sets, lastInsertId, and beginTransaction, commit and rollBack around multi-statement work.

topics.title: Repositories and migrations
topics.description: Wrapping queries in repository classes, mapping rows to typed objects, versioned schema migrations with Phinx or Doctrine Migrations, and seeding; SQL itself lives in the SQL track.

topics.title: Cross-site scripting defences
topics.description: How XSS happens when untrusted data reaches HTML, attributes, scripts or URLs unescaped, context-aware escaping, Content Security Policy headers, and safe handling of rich text.

topics.title: CSRF protection
topics.description: Why a browser sends cookies on cross-site requests, synchroniser tokens in forms, SameSite cookies, checking Origin headers, and making state changes POST-only.

topics.title: Injection beyond SQL
topics.description: Command injection through exec and shell_exec, path traversal in file paths, LDAP and header injection, escapeshellarg, realpath checks and allow-lists.

topics.title: Password hashing and authentication
topics.description: password_hash with bcrypt or Argon2id, password_verify and password_needs_rehash, rate limiting logins, secure random tokens with random_bytes, and timing-safe comparison.

topics.title: Configuration and deployment hardening
topics.description: Secrets in environment variables, disabling display_errors and expose_php in production, open_basedir, keeping vendor and .env outside the web root, and HTTPS everywhere.

topics.title: PHPUnit basics
topics.description: Test classes and methods, assertions, phpunit.xml configuration, running a filtered subset, and reading failures with diffs.

topics.title: Data providers, fixtures and mocks
topics.description: Table-driven tests with data providers, setUp and tearDown, mocking interfaces with createMock and expectations, and testing exceptions with expectException.

topics.title: Testing database and HTTP code
topics.description: Integration tests against SQLite in memory, transactions rolled back per test, testing handlers through PSR-7 requests, and separating fast unit suites from slower integration suites.

topics.title: Performance and OPcache
topics.description: How OPcache removes recompilation, preloading, profiling with Xdebug or Blackfire, avoiding N+1 queries, caching with APCu or Redis, and the PHP 8 JIT in perspective.

categories.title: Laravel Overview
categories.description: How the most common PHP framework organises an application; the full framework has its own track (Laravel).

topics.title: Laravel project structure and Artisan
topics.description: Creating an app with the installer or Composer, the app, routes, config and resources folders, .env configuration, and Artisan commands for generating code and serving.

topics.title: Routing, controllers and Blade
topics.description: Defining routes with parameters and middleware, controllers and route model binding, and Blade templates with layouts, components and automatic escaping.

topics.title: Eloquent ORM essentials
topics.description: Models mapped to tables, migrations and factories, relationships like hasMany and belongsTo, eager loading with with() against N+1, and the query builder.

topics.title: Validation, auth and queues at a glance
topics.description: Form requests and validation rules, built-in authentication scaffolding and middleware, and queued jobs for slow work; each is covered in depth in the Laravel track.

topics.title: Project: CLI link checker
topics.description: Build a Composer-packaged command that reads URLs from a file or STDIN, fetches them concurrently with curl_multi, reports status codes and redirects, and exits non-zero on failures, with PHPUnit tests.

topics.title: Project: guestbook with sessions and PDO
topics.description: A small site with a form that validates input, stores entries via prepared statements in SQLite, paginates them, escapes output, protects against CSRF and keeps a login session for moderation.

topics.title: Project: JSON REST API with routing
topics.description: A dependency-free API with a front controller, a router, PSR-style request and response objects, a repository over PDO, token authentication, and integration tests.

topics.title: Project: CSV import pipeline
topics.description: Stream a large CSV with a generator, validate and normalise rows, upsert into a database in batched transactions, report rejects to a file, and make the job rerunnable.

topics.title: PHP interview questions
topics.description: The recurring questions: == versus ===, arrays as hash maps, references versus handles, traits versus interfaces, prepared statements, session security, generators, and what PHP 8 changed.

topics.title: Coding interviews in PHP
topics.description: Solving problems fast in PHP: reading STDIN, array functions as building blocks, SplPriorityQueue, string building, sorting with callbacks, and the traps of copy-on-write arrays.

title: Pipeline Monitoring
description: Operating data pipelines like production services: what to monitor (freshness, volume, schema, distribution, lineage), SLAs and SLOs for data, structured logging, Prometheus and Grafana, alerting and on-call, observability tools, cost monitoring, runbooks, postmortems and streaming lag.

code.label: Python, YAML and PromQL, whichever fits

categories.title: What to Monitor
categories.description: The five pillars of data observability and why each catches a different failure.

topics.title: Freshness
topics.description: How long since a dataset last updated compared with its expected cadence; freshness is the first thing consumers notice and the easiest signal to compute from a max timestamp or last-run record.

topics.title: Volume
topics.description: Row counts and bytes per load compared with recent history; a sudden drop signals lost data, a spike signals duplicates or a runaway upstream, and both hide behind a successful job status.

topics.title: Schema changes
topics.description: Detecting added, removed or retyped columns at the source and in the warehouse before they break transformations; comparing information_schema snapshots and registering expected schemas.

topics.title: Distribution
topics.description: Null rates, distinct counts, category shares and numeric ranges tracked over time; distribution shifts reveal upstream bugs and silent semantic changes that counts and freshness miss.

topics.title: Lineage as a monitoring signal
topics.description: Knowing which upstream jobs feed a dataset lets a monitor explain a failure and predict which dashboards will be stale, turning isolated alerts into an impact map.

categories.title: SLAs, SLOs and SLIs for Data
categories.description: Turning expectations into numbers you can be held to.

topics.title: SLIs, SLOs and SLAs defined for data
topics.description: An SLI is a measurement (freshness lag), an SLO is a target on it (under 2 hours 99 percent of days), an SLA is the agreement and consequence; applying the service reliability vocabulary to datasets.

topics.title: Choosing targets and error budgets
topics.description: Setting targets from consumer needs and historical performance rather than aspiration, computing an error budget, and using budget burn to decide between shipping and fixing reliability.

topics.title: Measuring and reporting SLO compliance
topics.description: Recording SLI values per run in a table or metric, computing compliance over rolling windows, and publishing a status page or dashboard that consumers can check themselves.

topics.title: Tiering datasets by criticality
topics.description: Not every table deserves paging: tiering by business impact assigns stricter SLOs, alert routes and on-call to critical datasets and best-effort monitoring to the rest.

categories.title: Logging for Data Jobs
categories.description: Logs that answer questions during an incident instead of adding noise.

topics.title: Structured logging in pipelines
topics.description: Emitting JSON logs with run id, dataset, stage, row counts and durations so they can be queried; Python logging configuration, structlog, and correlating logs across tasks with a shared run id.

topics.title: Centralised log collection
topics.description: Shipping logs from Airflow, Spark and containers to Loki, Elasticsearch or CloudWatch; retention, indexing costs, and searching by run id and dataset during an incident.

topics.title: Run metadata and audit tables
topics.description: Writing one row per pipeline run with start, end, status, rows processed and watermark to a table, giving a queryable history that powers freshness, volume and SLO reporting.

topics.title: Tracing across pipeline stages
topics.description: OpenTelemetry traces that span extract, transform and load steps with timings, propagating context through orchestrators and services to see where time goes in a slow run.

categories.title: Metrics and Dashboards
categories.description: Prometheus and Grafana concepts applied to pipelines.

topics.title: Prometheus data model
topics.description: Time series identified by metric name and labels; counters, gauges, histograms and summaries; scraping versus pushing with the Pushgateway for batch jobs that finish before a scrape.

topics.title: Instrumenting pipelines with the Python client
topics.description: Using prometheus_client to expose or push job duration, rows in and out, failures and freshness, with labels for pipeline and dataset, and keeping label cardinality under control.

topics.title: PromQL for pipeline questions
topics.description: rate() on counters, time() minus a last-success timestamp for freshness, increase() over a day for volume, and histogram_quantile for duration percentiles; the queries behind pipeline dashboards and alerts.

topics.title: Grafana dashboards for data teams
topics.description: Dashboard layout by pipeline tier, panels for freshness, volume, duration and failures, template variables per dataset, annotations for deployments, and keeping dashboards few and readable.

topics.title: Exporters and integrations
topics.description: Airflow StatsD metrics, Kafka lag exporters, warehouse query history and cloud monitoring exported into Prometheus so one system holds the whole picture.

categories.title: Alerting and On-Call
categories.description: Waking the right person for the right reason.

topics.title: Alerting rules in Prometheus
topics.description: Rule files with expr, for and labels; severity labels, grouping by pipeline, and writing expressions that fire on sustained conditions rather than momentary spikes.

topics.title: Routing with Alertmanager
topics.description: Routes by label to Slack, email or PagerDuty, grouping related alerts into one notification, inhibition so an upstream failure silences downstream ones, and silences during maintenance.

topics.title: On-call for data teams
topics.description: Rotations, escalation policies, handover notes, and the difference between business-hours and 24/7 coverage; what a data on-call is expected to do and not do at 3 a.m.

topics.title: Alert quality and fatigue
topics.description: Reviewing alert volume, acknowledgement rates and time to resolve; deleting or tuning alerts that never lead to action, and adding runbook links so every page is actionable.

categories.title: Data Observability Tools
categories.description: Platforms that automate the pillars, and how they work under the hood.

topics.title: Monte Carlo and automated anomaly monitors
topics.description: How commercial data observability platforms learn baselines from warehouse metadata and query logs to alert on freshness, volume and schema without hand-written rules, plus their lineage and incident features.

topics.title: Elementary for dbt projects
topics.description: An open-source package that stores dbt run and test results in the warehouse, adds anomaly tests, generates a report and sends alerts; observability that lives inside the dbt workflow.

topics.title: Building your own observability layer
topics.description: A metrics collector that samples freshness, volume and schema into a table, a baseline job, an alerting job and a Grafana dashboard; when the DIY route beats buying.

topics.title: Warehouse-native monitoring features
topics.description: Snowflake data metric functions, BigQuery INFORMATION_SCHEMA and audit logs, Databricks Lakehouse Monitoring; using what the warehouse already exposes before adding tools.

categories.title: Cost and Streaming Monitoring
categories.description: Two specialised signals every data platform needs.

topics.title: Cost monitoring for pipelines
topics.description: Attributing compute and query cost to pipelines via tags, query labels and job metadata, tracking cost per run and per dataset, and alerting on cost anomalies as you would on failures.

subtopics.title: Cost attribution by tags and labels
Cost per run and per dataset

topics.title: Monitoring streaming consumer lag
topics.description: Lag per partition and per group as the primary health metric for stream consumers, exporting it, alerting on sustained growth, and pairing lag with throughput to distinguish slow consumers from bursty producers.

topics.title: Streaming job health metrics
topics.description: Checkpoint duration and failures, restart counts, watermark progress, backpressure and end-to-end latency for Flink and Spark streaming jobs, and what each anomaly usually indicates.

topics.title: Synthetic checks and canary records
topics.description: Sending a known record through a pipeline and timing its arrival at the sink as an end-to-end latency probe, and heartbeat checks that prove a pipeline is alive when no real data flows.

categories.title: Incidents, Runbooks and Postmortems
categories.description: Handling failures consistently and learning from them.

topics.title: Writing runbooks
topics.description: A runbook per alert: what the alert means, how to confirm it, first mitigation steps, who to contact and how to verify recovery; kept next to the code and linked from the alert.

topics.title: Data incident response
topics.description: Declaring severity, assigning an incident lead, communicating to consumers, containing bad data, and tracking the timeline; adapting the software incident process to data.

topics.title: Backfills and recovery
topics.description: Recovering from an incident by re-running affected intervals safely: idempotent tasks, ordering of dependent backfills, throttling, and verifying corrected data before announcing recovery.

topics.title: Blameless postmortems
topics.description: Reconstructing the timeline, finding contributing causes, deciding on monitoring and process changes, and tracking actions; postmortems as the main way monitoring improves.

topics.title: Project: pipeline metrics with Prometheus and Grafana
topics.description: Instrument an existing batch pipeline with prometheus_client, push duration, rows and last-success time to a Pushgateway, build a Grafana dashboard with freshness and volume panels, and add an alert rule for staleness.

topics.title: Project: freshness and volume monitor with SLO reporting
topics.description: A scheduled job that records freshness and row counts for every table in a schema, stores them in a run table, evaluates SLOs per tier, posts Slack alerts on breaches and renders a weekly compliance report.

topics.title: Project: streaming lag dashboard and alerts
topics.description: Deploy a Kafka lag exporter against a local cluster, run a deliberately slow consumer, chart lag and throughput in Grafana, alert on sustained lag growth with Alertmanager routing to Slack, and write the runbook.

topics.title: Project: incident simulation and postmortem
topics.description: Inject a schema change into a source, watch which monitors fire and how long detection took, run the incident process with a lead and consumer updates, backfill the fix, and write a postmortem with new monitors.

subtopics.title: Write the postmortem and add monitors

topics.title: Pipeline monitoring interview questions
topics.description: What you would monitor first, how to define a freshness SLO, how alerting avoids noise, reading a Grafana panel, diagnosing rising lag, and how you handled a data incident.

topics.title: Designing monitoring for a case study
topics.description: Given a platform with batch loads, dbt models and a Kafka stream, propose the metrics, SLOs, dashboards, alert routes, on-call model and runbooks, with costs and a rollout order.
